Sprite Studio — the in-game avatar and sprite editor.

Companion to src/ref/wip/avatars-and-sprite-studio-plan.md. Every screen here maps to a phase in that document.

All character art is real: generated from the game's own Stage 0 prompts, matted and cropped by the actual pipeline math.

Phase 5. The cleanup sliders ARE CUTOUT_TUNING — same fields, same functions, running live against the preserved master.

This is what unsticks the cutout plan: it turns a tuning gate nobody in the repo can see into a slider the player can drag.

Phase 7. The crop shown is what D9 actually produced on this image — proportional basis, no neck found, side 0.269 of figure height.

D9 was rewritten mid-session after failing against real silhouettes. See refs/out/REPORT.md.

Phase 1, and the spine of the whole plan.

If you read one artboard, read this one — everything else depends on generated art and authored art living in different places with different rules.
